requirements.remaining: Approved SMS/IVR/appointment provider, real receipts and incoming opt-outs.

requirements.title: Worker activity evidence
requirements.requirement: The system shall generate a reviewable record of verified worker activities for programme reporting or incentive support. It shall distinguish performed, claimed, verified and submitted activity and avoid promising payment.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Correcting or cancelling an activity updates derived claims and leaves the original evidence and review history traceable.
requirements.current: Visit-backed outreach completion and correction-aware evidence.
requirements.remaining: Separate claimed/performed/verified/submitted activity and buyer reporting/claim reconciliation.

requirements.title: Operational exception queues
requirements.requirement: Supervisors shall see overdue work, identity conflicts, rejected submissions, unresolved clinical reviews and synchronisation problems within their scope. Queues shall identify owner, age and recovery action.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Each seeded failure is discoverable and assignable without searching individual worker transcripts.
requirements.current: Operational backlog counts plus R10 identity/ownership/handover queues.
requirements.remaining: Unified assignable clinical review, sync and destination exception queues with age/recovery action.

requirements.title: Governed indicator definitions
requirements.requirement: Each indicator shall define numerator, denominator, exclusions, period, source, update cadence and owner. Changes shall be versioned; historical reports shall remain reproducible.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A reviewer can recalculate sample indicators from authorised records and distinguish visits, unique people and accepted programme submissions.
requirements.current: Fixed operational definitions and documented denominators/window. Slice 6d adds eight versioned indicator definitions with numerator, denominator, exclusions, owner and cadence.
requirements.remaining: Versioned indicator registry, owner/exclusion/cadence and historical reproducibility.

requirements.title: Data freshness and completeness
requirements.requirement: Reports shall disclose late arrivals, missing sources, external outages and refresh times. A partially synchronised period shall not look equivalent to a complete reporting period.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Disconnecting one source produces a visible completeness warning and an explicit affected denominator.
requirements.current: Generation window and usage coverage limitations are visible. Slice 6d indicator results state computation time, window, cohort size and latest source record.
requirements.remaining: Source-specific freshness, late arrivals and affected reporting denominators.

requirements.title: Privacy-preserving aggregation
requirements.requirement: Reports shall enforce audience-specific aggregation and small-cell controls. Patient-level drilldown and exports shall require an approved purpose and separate access.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Combining filters cannot reveal a suppressed small group or bypass person-level access restrictions.
requirements.current: Current team scope and administrator patient-aggregate denial. Slice 6d indicator queries refuse cohorts under 5 and suppress small and complementary cells.
requirements.remaining: Differencing protection across queries, suppression on exports and a separate purpose for patient exports.

requirements.title: Reconciled exports
requirements.requirement: Exports shall identify report definition, period, filters, generation time and user, with protected access and expiry where appropriate. Official reporting shall pass a review and submission state distinct from a draft export.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An exported report reconciles to the displayed governed measure and cannot be downloaded by an unauthorised role.
requirements.current: Audited scoped CSV with generation time/window and formula escaping.
requirements.remaining: Definition version, exporting actor, protected expiry and official reviewed-submission lifecycle.

requirements.title: Population prioritisation
requirements.requirement: Approved risk or gap-analysis tools may identify populations needing review. Such results shall identify data limitations and support human planning rather than automatically denying service or ranking worker pay.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Supervisors can inspect selection criteria and override an allocation with a reason; uncertainty remains visible.
requirements.current: Human cohort selection with recorded criteria and allocation rationale.
requirements.remaining: Approved gap/risk measures and real data-quality/fairness validation.

requirements.title: Product performance metrics
requirements.requirement: The platform shall measure reuse, task completion, corrections, provider usage, sync failures and support burden without storing raw sensitive content in general analytics.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Product dashboards can support the Section 6 evaluation and contain no unnecessary patient identifiers or recording content.
requirements.current: Privacy-safe route metrics, task counts and partial agent usage. Slice 2a adds reuse, blocked reuse, repeated-entry and correction indicators.
requirements.remaining: Sync and support burden measurements and pilot evaluation of the reuse and correction figures.

requirements.title: Deployment configuration
requirements.requirement: Administrators shall configure organisation, geography, facilities, roles, programmes, languages, provider eligibility and operational limits. Changes shall be scoped to the deployment and validated before activation.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Updating one tenant's configuration cannot change another tenant's behaviour or data visibility.
requirements.current: Tenant/team/member and selected provider/connector settings are scoped.
requirements.remaining: Facilities, jurisdiction, full language/provider eligibility and validated deployment limits.

requirements.title: Separation of environments
requirements.requirement: Development, demonstration, training and production environments shall have separate identities, data and credentials. Synthetic data shall be clearly identifiable and blocked from production programme submissions.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A demonstration record cannot reach a live MIS, and a training account cannot access real patient records.
requirements.current: Synthetic environment labels, private deployment and disabled real credentials.
requirements.remaining: Separate production/training identities, data/credentials and enforceable synthetic-to-live barrier.

requirements.title: Controlled publishing and rollback
requirements.requirement: Programme packs, language content, knowledge sources, model versions and mappings shall use review, approval, publication and rollback states. Sensitive changes require independent approval and an impact summary.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A failed change is reversible to an approved version while preserving the history of work completed under the changed version.
requirements.current: Source versions and independent template/proposal reviews.
requirements.remaining: Unified pack/language/knowledge/model/mapping publication, impact review and approved rollback.

requirements.title: Operational monitoring
requirements.requirement: Operators shall monitor platform health, connector failures, pending queues, model availability, permission anomalies and costs. Alerts shall identify severity, affected scope, accountable owner and required response.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An induced provider outage and a stalled writeback queue reach the correct support owner within the agreed alert target.
requirements.current: Hourly request metrics, incidents, queue counts and cost assumptions.
requirements.remaining: Actionable alert routing with owners and approved detection/response targets.

requirements.title: Support without unnecessary disclosure
requirements.requirement: Users shall raise a support case from a failed task using redacted diagnostics. Access to additional patient content shall be limited to authorised support personnel, purpose and duration.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A routine support agent can diagnose a sync failure without unrestricted patient access; exceptional access is logged and expires.
requirements.current: Redacted technical support export and generic incidents.
requirements.remaining: Task-linked support cases and purpose/time-limited exceptional support access.

requirements.title: Training and competency
requirements.requirement: Training shall cover patient matching, correction, offline states, model limits, escalation and real submission status. Users shall practise in a safe environment and demonstrate core competencies before live activation.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Activation records show training completion and role-specific competency evidence for the pilot cohort.
requirements.current: Synthetic training assessment and personal acknowledgement records.
requirements.remaining: Real cohort competency, actual training delivery and activation enforcement.

requirements.title: Data exit and continuity
requirements.requirement: The buyer shall be able to export its authorised operational records, configuration and audit evidence in documented formats under the agreement. Provider or platform termination shall include queue disposition and care-task handover.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An exit rehearsal produces a usable export, a list of unresolved external actions and a named owner for open patient tasks.
requirements.current: Local encrypted backup, configuration export and limited report/FHIR exports.
requirements.remaining: Buyer-scoped operational exit archive, independent re-import and named queue/task handover.

requirements.title: Repeatable deployment packaging
requirements.requirement: A deployment pack shall record approved settings, dependencies, training, tests and operating responsibilities. Country-specific rules shall be configurable without duplicating the entire product.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A second deployment can be assembled from the pack with explicit local differences and no copied production patient data.
requirements.current: Configuration-only proposal pack with local differences; no patient collection copied.
requirements.remaining: Installable approved deployment pack including training, tests and operating responsibility.

requirements.title: Purpose and lawful authority
requirements.requirement: Every material data flow shall record its purpose, responsible organisation, applicable authority or processing basis, recipient and retention rule. Consent-based flows shall carry the required consent; other authorised flows shall record their distinct basis.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A new provider or connector cannot activate without an approved data-flow record, and a user clicking confirm cannot override an absent processing basis.
requirements.current: Local AI/sharing flags and EHR purpose/direction/time permissions.
requirements.remaining: Approved processing inventory and enforceable authority/recipient/retention basis for every flow.

requirements.title: Understandable notice and consent
requirements.requirement: Where consent is required, the workflow shall present a reviewed notice in an appropriate language and record scope, notice version, person or authorised representative, decision, time and expiry. Optional use shall be distinguishable from essential service steps.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Declining an optional AI recording leaves the approved non-AI care workflow available and prevents that media from being sent.
requirements.current: Optional AI can be declined; contact preferences and EHR scopes are recorded.
requirements.remaining: Reviewed multilingual notices, notice versions, representative authority and full expiry semantics.

requirements.title: Withdrawal and downstream effects
requirements.requirement: Withdrawal, expiry or change of authorisation shall stop future affected processing and identify queued, cached and externally held data requiring action. Retention obligations and completed lawful transactions shall be handled under the approved policy.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Revocation blocks a queued provider upload and produces a traceable disposition record; the system does not claim to erase an external record without evidence.
requirements.current: Revocation blocks pending use; contact changes cancel reminders; receipts remain visible.
requirements.remaining: Disposition queue for cached/externally held data and verified downstream outcomes.

requirements.title: Sensitive data and proxy handling
requirements.requirement: The system shall support additional restrictions for sensitive programme information, children, adolescents and proxy relationships as defined for the jurisdiction and care context. Relationship, authority and expiry shall be recorded separately.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A household member cannot infer restricted information through summaries, notifications, shared schedules or access to another member's encounter.
requirements.current: Slice 1: sensitive classes (maternal, TB, adolescent, child) derived per person; household sharing withholds items revealing a class the proxy grant does not name, and omits members without a grant. Not yet applied to notifications, exports or model payloads.
requirements.remaining: Jurisdiction-specific sensitivity restrictions and relationship/authority/expiry enforcement.

requirements.title: Encryption and secrets
requirements.requirement: Sensitive data shall be protected in transit and at rest, including local caches, backups and media. Secrets shall be managed outside client code, prompts, logs and configuration exports, with ownership and rotation procedures.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Security review finds no usable provider keys in the client bundle or agent context, and local data is unreadable outside the authorised application.
requirements.current: TLS hosting, server secrets, encrypted field vault and encrypted local backups.
requirements.remaining: Independent storage/key-management, rotation, media and end-to-end encryption assessment.

requirements.title: Tenant and record isolation
requirements.requirement: Isolation shall apply to transactional records, searches, indexes, retrieval stores, reports, file links, backups and asynchronous tasks. High-privilege operations shall require explicit scoped authority.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Cross-tenant adversarial tests and wrong-record reference tests result in denial with no content disclosure.
requirements.current: Organisation/patient scope tested across current APIs and exports.
requirements.remaining: Independent adversarial coverage of hosted backup, future indexes/media and asynchronous services.

requirements.title: Safe logs and analytics
requirements.requirement: Application logs, crash reports, support exports and usage analytics shall minimise or redact identifiers and clinical content. Necessary sensitive diagnostic records shall have separate access and retention.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A representative end-to-end test leaves no raw recording, credential or complete patient narrative in general operational telemetry.
requirements.current: Fixed route/status telemetry and redacted support exports.
requirements.remaining: Full production logging, crash-report retention and sensitive diagnostic policy review.

requirements.title: Audit evidence
requirements.requirement: The platform shall record material reads, writes, approvals, AI calls, exports, configuration changes and privileged access with actor, authority, affected object, time, outcome and version. Ordinary users shall not be able to alter audit history.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An auditor reconstructs a selected encounter and submission from evidence without relying on the chat transcript or provider recollection.
requirements.current: Writes/approvals/exports have append-only audit and revisions.
requirements.remaining: Material-read audit coverage, audit authority/version completeness and independent reconstruction.

requirements.title: Controlled retention and disposal
requirements.requirement: Retention shall be specified by record class, purpose, location and jurisdiction, including transcripts, raw audio, model outputs, local caches, audit and backups. Legal holds and clinical record duties shall override routine disposal only through recorded policy.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Test data expires according to its configured schedule, while held records remain protected and identifiable; backup restoration does not silently revive deleted operational data.
requirements.current: Slice 6c: owner-set, versioned retention schedules for six record classes, patient and organisation holds, and a per-class eligibility review. No record is deleted.
requirements.remaining: Approved record-class schedule, tombstones, restore-safe disposal and coverage of backups and exports.

requirements.title: Rights and correction workflow
requirements.requirement: The deployment shall provide a route for access, correction, grievances and applicable deletion or restriction requests. Identity verification shall be proportionate, and downstream dependencies shall be tracked.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A test request reaches the responsible organisation, has a due date under its approved policy and closes only with an evidence-backed outcome.
requirements.current: Slice 6b: access, correction, restriction, deletion and grievance requests with identity or proxy-authority check, 30-day local due date, owner, destination notification items, outcome evidence and an enforced processing restriction.
requirements.remaining: Legally reviewed policy, verified requester channel, copy-of-record package, grievance escalation and retention-based deletion.

requirements.title: Emergency and support access
requirements.requirement: Any exceptional access shall have a defined eligible role, reason, time limit, minimum scope and retrospective review. It shall not create permanent access or bypass clinical authority.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A break-glass event is visible to the designated reviewer and automatically expires; an ordinary worker cannot invoke it unless specifically authorised.
requirements.current: Slice 6a: clinician emergency access to one out-of-scope patient by record reference, 15 minutes to 4 hours, with reason, caps, urgent-care actions only, audit and single independent review by the patient's team.
requirements.remaining: Approved eligibility policy, support-staff access, step-up authentication, team notification and material-read audit during access.

requirements.title: Provider and supply-chain assurance
requirements.requirement: Providers and critical dependencies shall disclose security controls, subprocessors, incident contacts and material changes. The product shall maintain a dependency inventory and a process for vulnerable or unsupported components.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An unresolved critical vulnerability affecting the deployment blocks release or disables the affected component until the approved remedy is implemented.
requirements.current: Dependency lockfile and provider configuration inventory. Slice 0c: production SBOM (CycloneDX) and an audit gate failing on critical advisories or high advisories present in the built bundle.
requirements.remaining: SBOM/vulnerability gates, supplier controls/subprocessors and material-change assurance.

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.requirement: Security and privacy incidents shall have triage, containment, evidence preservation, impact assessment and notification responsibilities. The relevant legal and contractual notification windows shall be maintained per deployment rather than hard-coded as a universal rule.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A tabletop exercise demonstrates who acts, what access is revoked, how affected records are found and how notification decisions are documented.
requirements.current: Incident owner/triage/evidence and maintenance/suspension controls.
requirements.remaining: Impact discovery, notification policy and recorded security/privacy tabletop exercise.

requirements.title: Hosting and cross-border controls
requirements.requirement: Approved data locations and transfer restrictions shall apply to primary storage, AI providers, backups, analytics and support access. Region selection shall be enforced across the processing chain.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A model endpoint or support route outside the deployment's permitted locations is rejected before personal data is transferred.
requirements.current: Explicit HTTPS origin allowlist limits outbound destinations.
requirements.remaining: Enforced legal data-location policy across storage, providers, backups, analytics and support.

requirements.title: No invented facts
requirements.requirement: The platform shall never fill an unanswered clinical or programme field with an assumed answer. It may calculate a derived value only where the formula and required inputs are approved and the result is labelled as derived.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Missing, refused and uncertain inputs remain distinguishable across local records, model calls and outgoing submissions.
requirements.current: Unknown facts remain unknown; stale or absent rule inputs surface missing evidence and cannot silently become normal.
requirements.remaining: Distinct missing/refused/uncertain semantics across every downstream resource.

requirements.title: Patient confirmation before commitment
requirements.requirement: The workflow shall require a positive person-context check before confirming an encounter or sending a patient-specific external action. Ambiguous identity shall restrict action to the allowed provisional workflow.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A deliberately ambiguous match cannot create an authoritative programme update until the identity requirement is resolved.
requirements.current: R10 version-bound positive patient check; provisional identity blocks consequential actions.
requirements.remaining: Partner-specific identity requirements and all downstream clinical commitment acceptance.

requirements.title: Review depends on unchanged evidence
requirements.requirement: An approval shall be bound to the material facts, intended action, destination and relevant versions reviewed. Material changes shall invalidate it and require an appropriate new review.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Editing a measurement after referral approval prevents silent use of the previous approval for a changed recommendation.
requirements.current: Visit/person/consent/connector/plan versions bind approvals and stale actions fail.
requirements.remaining: Independent evidence review across the final clinical/integration catalogue.

requirements.title: Honest completion and cancellation
requirements.requirement: Local completion, external acceptance and service completion shall be distinct. Cancelling a local task shall not falsely cancel an accepted external transaction; a separate authorised correction or cancellation request is required.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Cancellation after submission reports the actual destination state and generates any remaining reversal task.
requirements.current: Local/simulator/external outcomes remain distinct and receipts are not silently reversed.
requirements.remaining: Evidence-backed downstream reversal/correction tasks for each supported partner.

requirements.title: No false model equivalence
requirements.requirement: Provider outputs shall retain their meaning and intended use. Confidence scores from different models shall not be treated as directly comparable without an approved interpretation and evaluation.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: A multi-model result screen avoids a fabricated common score and presents the required review path for disagreement.
requirements.current: Provider results stay separate; no common clinical risk score is produced.
requirements.remaining: Approved composition/disagreement policy if combined clinical outputs are introduced.

requirements.title: Rechecks at execution time
requirements.requirement: Permission, person linkage, capability status and relevant authorisation shall be checked immediately before an external action, even if planning occurred earlier.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Revoking a worker's role between drafting and execution blocks the pending action and preserves it for authorised reassignment.
requirements.current: Current permissions, linkage, consent and versions checked before guarded execution.
requirements.remaining: Real gateway/provider revocation and in-flight lifecycle acceptance.

requirements.title: No experimental output in care
requirements.requirement: Training, synthetic, shadow or unapproved model results shall be segregated from the operational care record and shall not influence user-visible clinical action lists.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: An experimental high-risk result cannot trigger a live referral or patient notification outside an explicitly authorised evaluation protocol.
requirements.current: Synthetic workspace and explicit simulation labels; live credentials absent.
requirements.remaining: Hard environment segregation and experimental-result exclusion from future production care.

requirements.title: No silent adverse allocation
requirements.requirement: The agent shall not independently deny services, sanction benefits, determine worker incentives or impose employment consequences. Any later support for such decisions requires a separately approved scope and review process.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Requests for an automatic denial or sanction produce no operational transaction and identify the required authority.
requirements.current: Closed command catalogue has no denial, benefit sanction, pay or employment transaction.
requirements.remaining: Independent adversarial acceptance of the final agent catalogue.

requirements.title: Core availability
requirements.requirement: The central platform shall target 99.5 percent monthly availability for core authenticated record and workflow services. Report planned maintenance and upstream outages separately; publish a second end-to-end measure including dependencies.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Synthetic probes, error logs and incident records reconcile to a monthly report with transparent exclusions.
requirements.current: Request telemetry exists; no monthly availability measurement.
requirements.remaining: Synthetic probes and transparent core/end-to-end availability reporting against 99.5 percent target.

requirements.title: Responsive field interface
requirements.requirement: On the reference device, local field saves shall complete within 500 ms at the 95th percentile and cached patient or task screens within 2 seconds. Connected core screens shall target 3 seconds at the 95th percentile under the reference network.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Instrument representative tasks under R1 load and report failed requests and slow outliers, not just averages.
requirements.current: Bounded desktop/local report timing only.
requirements.remaining: Reference Android/network/workload p95 measurements for saves and screens.

requirements.title: Visible AI progress
requirements.requirement: An online AI task shall acknowledge its state within 2 seconds and display progress or an honest pending state. Each capability shall have an approved completion deadline; a default interactive deadline of 30 seconds is proposed, with longer asynchronous tasks clearly identified.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Timeout and delayed-provider tests show usable status and preserve the underlying encounter workflow.
requirements.current: Durable agent/evaluation checkpoints, visible case progress and provider deadlines; no automatic resend.
requirements.remaining: Two-second acknowledgement and task-specific completion evidence under representative load.

requirements.title: No loss of acknowledged local work
requirements.requirement: Acknowledged local saves shall survive application crash, routine restart and temporary power loss on supported devices. No record may be marked saved before durable persistence. Device destruction remains outside this guarantee until synchronisation.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Fault injection recovers all acknowledged records and identifies any unacknowledged inputs as unsaved.
requirements.current: Encrypted write acknowledgement/recovery logic tested with injected storage.
requirements.remaining: Crash, restart and power-loss tests on supported physical devices.

requirements.title: Duplicate-safe execution
requirements.requirement: Repeated delivery, retries and replay of the same logical action shall not create duplicate business events where the connector contract supports idempotency or reconciliation. Unsupported cases shall remain unresolved instead of being blindly retried.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: At least 10000 replay and timeout test events produce no duplicate accepted activity in the supported connector fixtures.
requirements.current: Replay/CAS/uncertain-receipt tests pass on bounded fixtures.
requirements.remaining: At least 10000 replay/timeout events with no duplicate accepted partner activity.

requirements.title: Server recovery
requirements.requirement: The proposed server recovery point objective is at most 15 minutes and recovery time objective at most 4 hours. The accepted architecture may improve these limits. Locally queued work shall reconcile after recovery rather than being discarded.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: A documented restore exercise measures actual recovery, integrity and replay of affected outstanding work.
requirements.current: Encrypted local snapshot/restore and restarted Worker drill.
requirements.remaining: Hosted measured RPO at most 15 minutes and RTO at most four hours.

requirements.title: Data integrity
requirements.requirement: Confirmed records shall retain referential integrity, valid units and complete version history through capture, sync, amendment and export. Checks shall detect orphan identities, missing receipts and invalid state transitions.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Release reconciliation covers every generated record in the migration and failure test corpus, with zero unexplained loss.
requirements.current: Foreign keys, append-only revisions and migration/restore integrity checks.
requirements.remaining: Complete corpus reconciliation across media/canonical resources and all partner corrections.

requirements.title: Security release posture
requirements.requirement: Production shall have no unresolved critical or high-severity exploitable findings within the agreed security assessment scope. Findings must be remediated or the affected capability removed before launch.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Independent review covers access control, mobile storage, APIs, secrets, file access, agent tool abuse and tenant isolation.
requirements.current: Local negative security tests; no independent production assessment.
requirements.remaining: Independent assessment with no unresolved exploitable critical/high findings in agreed scope.

requirements.title: Online revocation
requirements.requirement: Role removal or account suspension shall stop new online access and actions within 5 minutes. A disconnected device is constrained by its offline grant and local lock policy; it cannot be promised immediate remote revocation.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Session, background job and reconnect tests enforce the limit and record the residual offline window.
requirements.current: Current membership checked on every online operation and reconnect.
requirements.remaining: Measured production revocation across sessions, background jobs and devices within five minutes.

requirements.title: Audit completeness and timing
requirements.requirement: All mandatory audit events shall be durable before or atomically with the consequential action where feasible. If durable audit cannot be established, external writes and privileged changes shall stop. Local capture may continue with its local audit queue.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Audit-store failure blocks the designated actions, while recovery preserves event order and detects clock skew.
requirements.current: Audit/receipts committed atomically; external calls use durable checkpoints.
requirements.remaining: Audit-store fault injection, clock skew and every designated external/privileged action.

requirements.title: Offline capacity and controlled storage
requirements.requirement: The reference device shall retain 200 structured unsynchronised encounters plus 100 media items of up to 4 MB each within a proposed 500 MB data allowance. Capability-approved media formats take precedence; larger media require a separately accepted profile.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Capacity, low-storage and restart tests show warnings and no silent deletion of unsynchronised data.
requirements.current: Ten structured drafts; no media queue.
requirements.remaining: 200 encounters plus 100 media items within approved storage allowance, exhaustion/restart tests.

requirements.title: Synchronisation recovery
requirements.requirement: On stable reconnection, 95 percent of eligible structured records in a 200-record queue shall reach the platform within 5 minutes under reference network conditions. Media and external destination acceptance have separate measures.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Queue tests measure completion, rejected records, permission rechecks and remaining unresolved items.
requirements.current: Small queue sync/replay logic is tested.
requirements.remaining: 200-record queue with 95 percent eligible sync within five minutes on reference network.

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.requirement: Web workflows shall target WCAG 2.2 AA; mobile workflows shall implement corresponding applicable principles and native accessibility support [S6]. Essential tasks shall support readable scaling, labelled controls, focus navigation and non-colour status cues.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Automated assessment plus manual assistive-technology and representative-user testing covers all core journeys.
requirements.current: Labelled primitives, focusable controls and responsive CSS. Slice 6e: axe-core WCAG 2.0–2.2 A/AA rules report no violations on 16 owner and ASHA screens and dialogs after contrast fixes (271 contrast failures before).
requirements.remaining: Automated coverage of the field notebook, populated panels, error states, mobile and Hindi screens; screen-reader, keyboard-only, zoom and representative-user review; independent accessibility review.

requirements.title: Usability and training burden
requirements.requirement: At least 90 percent of representative participants shall complete core tasks without facilitator intervention after standard training. Record errors, recovery time and programme understanding, not only task speed.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Proposed evaluation includes at least 20 representative frontline users and 5 supervisors, with results disaggregated by language and device familiarity.
requirements.current: Agent browser walkthroughs only.
requirements.remaining: At least 20 frontline users and five supervisors, task completion/error/recovery evidence.

requirements.title: Language quality
requirements.requirement: Critical UI, counselling and escalation content shall receive qualified human review in each supported language. Numeric extraction, negation and clinical terms require task-specific evaluation; aggregate speech word error rate alone is insufficient.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Reviewers accept the language corpus, and all safety-critical benchmark cases meet the approved pass criteria.
requirements.current: Hindi/English notebook strings and neutral reminder copies exist.
requirements.remaining: Qualified review of critical translations and language safety benchmark acceptance.

requirements.title: AI extraction quality
requirements.requirement: The proposed administrative extraction target is at least 95 percent precision and recall for required nonclinical fields on a representative annotated corpus. Critical clinical fields require confirmation regardless of extraction score; clinical model targets remain capability-specific.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Report field-level errors, language and noise subgroups, missingness and correction burden against a versioned test set.
requirements.current: Fixed 18-case corpus with field/language/group precision, recall, false positives/misses; English parser fixture pass and Hindi failure recorded.
requirements.remaining: Representative independently annotated corpus, clinical subgroups, correction burden and accuracy acceptance.

requirements.title: Clinical and agent safety evaluation
requirements.requirement: The release suite shall include all approved critical scenarios for escalation, role boundaries, wrong-patient context, unsupported use and adversarial instructions. All release-blocking cases must pass; passing the suite is not proof of zero clinical risk.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Named reviewers sign the results and link every unresolved lower-severity issue to an owner and disposition.
requirements.current: Synthetic adversarial/source-context, stale governance, scope, lifecycle, safety-hold and referral-dependency tests.
requirements.remaining: Approved clinical escalation/adversarial corpus, independent named reviewer sign-off and issue disposition.

requirements.title: Operational observability
requirements.requirement: Major platform, queue or connector failures shall generate an actionable alert within 5 minutes of detection criteria being met. Traces shall link a user task to provider calls and destination receipts without exposing unnecessary clinical content.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Induced failures reach the correct queue and permit reconstruction using redacted diagnostic data.
requirements.current: Redacted request IDs, metrics and manual incidents.
requirements.remaining: Five-minute actionable alerts linking tasks, provider calls and destination receipts.

requirements.title: Maintainable configuration
requirements.requirement: Common content, language, indicator and workflow changes shall follow versioned configuration paths where possible. They shall not require ad hoc database edits or undocumented production scripts.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: A programme change is reviewed, tested, deployed and rolled back through the documented operating process.
requirements.current: Some versioned settings and source rollback runbooks.
requirements.remaining: Unified reviewed configuration publication/rollback without ad hoc production edits.

requirements.title: Integration conformance
requirements.requirement: Every live connector and provider adapter shall pass the agreed contract suite, including invalid data, permissions, timeout, duplicate requests and incompatible versions. External conformance requirements shall be version-pinned where applicable.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Test results are linked to the exact deployed connector, mapping and provider versions.
requirements.current: Agent/MIS/EHR contract suites with pinned local contracts and injected transport.
requirements.remaining: Exact deployed live adapter and external profile conformance evidence.

requirements.title: Cost transparency
requirements.requirement: At least 99 percent of billable AI and communication events shall be attributable to a tenant, capability and task or explicit system activity. Budget alerts and hard limits shall use the defined safety-aware fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Usage records reconcile with provider invoices or test billing evidence; unexplained variance is investigated.
requirements.current: Known agent token usage and explicit missing-cost coverage.
requirements.remaining: At least 99 percent billable event attribution, invoice reconciliation and monetary limits.

requirements.title: Data portability and export integrity
requirements.requirement: Authorised structured records shall be exportable with identifiers, relationships, units, provenance and version metadata. Export format documentation shall enable an independent party to interpret the data.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: A 1000-person test export is re-imported into a validation environment with complete record counts and relationships.
requirements.current: Local full-database restore and limited structured exports.
requirements.remaining: Buyer-authorised 1000-person portable export/re-import with complete relationships and provenance.

requirements.title: Disaster and downtime readiness
requirements.requirement: Operations shall have tested procedures for platform outage, lost device, unavailable model, destination failure and clinical service disruption. Emergency care guidance shall remain available through the approved local contingency process.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: Tabletop and technical exercises record actual recovery actions, communication ownership and unresolved gaps.
requirements.current: Local recovery tooling and documented downtime boundaries.
requirements.remaining: Hosted outage/lost-device/model/destination/service-disruption tabletop and technical acceptance.

requirements.title: Scale readiness
requirements.requirement: Before expanding to a proposed 10000 workers and 5 million person records, the product shall pass a separate capacity and operating-cost review. R1 performance evidence shall not be presented as proof of national-scale readiness.
requirements.acceptance: Verification: R2 load, isolation, storage, support and cost tests are run against the agreed production-like topology and volume.
requirements.current: Slice 0a adds patient-partitioned loads and per-patient commit guards; slice 0b-2 scopes workspace reads to the viewer, so a local probe measured an ASHA read at 48 ms with 50,006 people (965 ms before). Whole-team reads still grow with the team (38 MB at 50,006). Not scale evidence.
requirements.remaining: Partitioned architecture, topology/load/support/cost review before 10000-worker or five-million-person expansion.

requirements.title: Clinical exchange validation
requirements.requirement: One hundred percent of outbound structured clinical exchange payloads shall pass the pinned schema, profile, terminology and business-rule checks before submission. Validation warnings that are accepted by policy shall remain visible and versioned.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Verification: The release corpus covers every supported artefact and includes invalid cardinality, code, reference, unit, signature and bundle cases.
requirements.current: Structural subset FHIR and mapping validation.
requirements.remaining: Pinned schema/profile/terminology/business-rule corpus including signature and all supported artefacts.

requirements.title: Consent and exchange traceability
requirements.requirement: Every ABDM or direct EHR exchange shall be traceable from user purpose and authority through request, transformation, disclosure or receipt, acknowledgement and final state without placing raw clinical payloads in general application logs.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Verification: Audit reconstruction succeeds for all release exchanges, while log inspection confirms that secrets, tokens and unnecessary clinical content are absent.
requirements.current: Direct-EHR permission, operation and receipt ledger with redacted telemetry.
requirements.remaining: Complete ABDM/direct-EHR purpose-to-final-state audit and disclosure traceability.

requirements.title: Connector upgrade compatibility
requirements.requirement: A connector or FHIR package upgrade shall pass regression tests for existing mappings, queued actions, receipts, amendments and historical display before activation. In-flight work shall finish on its compatible version or enter controlled review.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Verification: A simulated breaking version change does not corrupt queued work or silently reinterpret historical records.
requirements.current: Changed connector/model versions block stale approvals and preserve old receipts.
requirements.remaining: Breaking upgrade tests for queued work, amendment semantics, historical display and profile packages.

requirements.title: Interoperability performance
requirements.requirement: Under the R1 workload, canonical transformation and local validation shall add no more than 500 ms at the 95th percentile for structured records, excluding external network and destination processing time. Batch and document workflows shall have separately declared targets.
requirements.acceptance: Acceptance: Verification: Instrumented tests report transformation, validation, queue and external latency separately for each connector type.
requirements.current: No representative transformation/validation latency benchmark.
requirements.remaining: Per-adapter p95 local overhead at most 500 ms under R1 workload, separate from external latency.
